overlay.scope: Generic exact point-value auxiliary storage extension; also supports ordinary Tiny controls without a word dictionary. Full word reduction is separately owned by verify_word_reference. Proved redundancy is owned by unchanged marking-certificate verification.

positive.affected_scope: Each whole-word port update represents all bytes of a complete aligned occurrence. Every occurrence contains its common origin, so union of all original byte dependencies equals the checked port dependency set. Scalar/t-support dependencies are unchanged; finite unions preserve all affected candidate sets.
positive.reduction_scope: Only states reached from the checked boundary by the complete checked placements: aligned complete canonical JSON words with nonbyte terminator256; scalar namespaces disjoint. Equal IDs iff equal full terminated words; unequal words conflict at first differing byte or shorter terminator. Partial/shifted words and arbitrary byte states are excluded.
positive.storage_scope: Full canonical payload compared once per distinct dictionary word; exact stdlib-compatible JSON container subtrees memoized with retained owners during a fixed-input audit. Same independently derived domains, ordered placements, incidence and complete dictionary comparison as v1. No old Model or Host/Native acceptance invoked.

word.scope: Synthetic constructor and reduction controls, not Native logical admissions or target-proof evidence. Generic auxiliary extension controls do not claim word reduction for arbitrary partial-byte states. Controls execute only inside a fresh reviewed Root actual.
